dz: 韦尔西尼基亚战役:克鲁姆所率领的布尔加尔人击败了伊迪尔内附近的拜占庭军队. 皇帝迈克尔一世被迫放弃支持亚美尼亚人利奥五世.
de: Battle of Versinikia: The Bulgars led by Krum defeat the Byzantine army near Edirne. Emperor Michael I is forced to abdicate in favor of Leo V the Armenian.

de: Byzantine emperor Michael I, under threat by conspiracies, abdicates in favor of his general Leo the Armenian, and becomes a monk (under the name Athanasius).

de: Leo V the Armenian is crowned as Byzantine Emperor after he successfully forced previous emperor Michael I Rangabe to abdicate the previous day.
